name: streamdeck-kit-monorepo
description: Stream Deck plugin kit (rendering, Panorama effects, property inspector) and its dev tools
author: Boris Kemper

scripts.check: npm run build && npm test && npm run lint
scripts.release:patch: npm run check && node tools/release.mjs patch
scripts.release:minor: npm run check && node tools/release.mjs minor
scripts.release:major: npm run check && node tools/release.mjs major
